kings-heath.distance: Foundry Gym is in Kings Heath itself
kings-heath.localIntro: Kings Heath is home. Foundry Gym sits just off the High Street, so most local clients are within a five-minute walk or a two-minute drive. Whether you live near the village, off Vicarage Road or up towards Highbury, your sessions are genuinely local — no cross-city commute, no excuses.

faqs.q: Where in Kings Heath do you train clients?
faqs.a: All sessions run from Foundry Gym just off the Kings Heath High Street — you're likely within a 5-10 minute walk or a two-minute drive. For outdoor work we use Kings Heath Park and Highbury Park up the road.

faqs.q: Is there parking near the gym in Kings Heath?
faqs.a: Yes. Foundry Gym has free on-site parking, and there's additional street parking around Institute Road and the High Street. Plenty of Kings Heath clients simply walk or cycle in.

faqs.q: Can I train around a job in the city centre?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Kings Heath is a 15-minute commute from central Birmingham on the 50 bus or the reopened Camp Hill line, so I run early 06:00 and late 21:00 slots for commuters.

faqs.q: Do you offer outdoor sessions in Kings Heath?
faqs.a: Yes — Kings Heath Park and Highbury Park are ideal for outdoor strength and conditioning. It's a fresh alternative to the gym and popular through the summer months.

faqs.q: How much does a personal trainer in Kings Heath cost?
faqs.a: Sessions start from £45 when booked in a block, £55 as a one-off. Small-group sessions work out cheaper per person. No contract — you pay as you go.
